description: This file defines an enumeration `DepositAccountOnHoldTransactionType` representing different on-hold transaction types for a `SavingsAccount` in the Fineract system, including methods for value mapping and checking transaction types.

classes.name: DepositAccountOnHoldTransactionType
classes.description: Enumeration of on-hold transaction types (INVALID, HOLD, RELEASE) with utility methods.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the integer value associated with the transaction type.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the string code associated with the transaction type.

methods.name: fromInt
methods.description: Static method to get the transaction type enum from an integer value.

methods.name: isHold
methods.description: Checks if the transaction type is HOLD.

methods.name: isRelease
methods.description: Checks if the transaction type is RELEASE.
